title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume adaptation of the Nintendo 64 game, split into a Child Saga and an Adult Saga. Young hero Link travels Hyrule seeking the Spiritual Stones with help from Princess Zelda to stop the evil king Ganondorf from ruling the land; while Link is absent for seven years, Ganondorf gains the power of the gods, the Triforce, and adult Link must return to stop him (AniList and MU descriptions).
life_message: Courage and perseverance in a just cause can overcome a tyrant's grab for power.

content.note: Sword fights against monsters and Ganondorf (AniList Swordplay, MU Sword/s, Invasion/s). Not graphic per Kids tag (to verify).
Video-game tie-in in a 21-volume Zelda manga line (MU).
